verdict.rationale: The only free path in the evidence is the interactive Search Playground, which docs say needs no API key. That allows no-cost experimentation in a browser, not programmatic API prototyping. The rate-limit docs describe tiers that advance as you spend on API credits, which implies paid prepaid credits rather than a free tier. Missing for 10: an explicit free API tier or free signup credits, documented free-usage limits for programmatic calls, free access beyond the Search Playground (e.g. Sonar/Agent API), independent confirmation of free prototyping.
